# Mereth Roleplay

> A serious roleplay Skyrim server on SkyMP, set in 4E 185, ten years after the
> White-Gold Concordat. Imperial rule is formally intact and Thalmor presence is
> growing. Play is player-driven: an economy, professions, holds with seated
> jarls, and magic that has to be taught to you by another player.

This site is the server's handbook. It is written to be looked things up in, so
each page below answers a different kind of question. Membership runs through
Discord, which is also the login.

## Start here

- [Mereth Roleplay](https://merethroleplay.com/): What Mereth is, live player and Discord counts, and the download.
- [Start Here](https://merethroleplay.com/start/): Joining from scratch: Discord login, the launcher, first character.
- [The Guide](https://merethroleplay.com/guide/): How the server works end to end, in chapters.
- [Rules](https://merethroleplay.com/rules/): The rulebook, with the severe rules flagged as severe.

## How the systems work

- [Skills and memory points](https://merethroleplay.com/skills/): The skill system: 18 memory points across 51 skills, with a planner and the in-game menu.
- [Progression](https://merethroleplay.com/progression/): What each tier is actually worth, and what a point buys.
- [Magic](https://merethroleplay.com/magic/): How magic is taught and gated: a master, a spellbook, a week per tier.
- [Food, drink and energy](https://merethroleplay.com/survival/): The three bars that tick down while you play, and how exhaustion works.
- [Crafting](https://merethroleplay.com/crafting/): Every recipe, bench by bench, with spawnable item ids.
- [Tips](https://merethroleplay.com/tips/): The numbers, the cooldowns and the traps.

## The setting

- [The World](https://merethroleplay.com/world/): Skyrim in 4E 185, ten years after the White-Gold Concordat.
- [The Nine Holds](https://merethroleplay.com/holds/): The nine holds and who holds each seat.
- [Factions](https://merethroleplay.com/factions/): The Companions, the College of Winterhold and the Thieves' Guild.
- [Lore](https://merethroleplay.com/lore/): The in-world library: eleven documents written for the setting.

## Answers

- [Questions](https://merethroleplay.com/faq/): Answers on skills, magic, combat, holds, and every connection failure.
- [Latest Q&A](https://merethroleplay.com/qa/): The latest community Q&A on where the server is heading.

## Reference

- [Changelog](https://merethroleplay.com/changelog/): Every release note, searchable and grouped by month.

## The lore library

- [The Companions](https://merethroleplay.com/lore/companions/): The hall at Whiterun, and the mantle nobody has claimed for forty years.
- [The Harbinger’s Reflections on the Decline of the Guild](https://merethroleplay.com/lore/harbinger-reflections/): A Harbinger writing on how the Companions declined.
- [Letter from Yjorn Gray-Mane, Custodian of the Skyforge](https://merethroleplay.com/lore/greymane-skyforge-letter/): The custodian of the Skyforge, on why his hammer is still.
- [Letters of a Shield Brother in Times of Turmoil](https://merethroleplay.com/lore/shield-brother-letters/): Letters between shield brothers during the turmoil.
- [The College of Winterhold](https://merethroleplay.com/lore/college-winterhold/): The College, its semesters, and what it asks of applicants.
- [The Thieves' Guild](https://merethroleplay.com/lore/thieves-guild/): What the Guild is in Skyrim, told plainly.
- [Atmoran Clevercraft](https://merethroleplay.com/lore/atmoran-clevercraft/): Clevercraft, and what Shalidor left behind.
- [On The Learnings of Bron Laah’dan](https://merethroleplay.com/lore/bron-laahdan-treatise/): A treatise dictated by a master, on the learnings of Bron Laah'dan.
- [The Vigilant Rule of 4E 35](https://merethroleplay.com/lore/vigilant-rule-4e35/): The rule written for the newly founded Knights Vigilant.
- [The Imperial Legion in Skyrim, 4E 185](https://merethroleplay.com/lore/imperial-legion-4e185/): An account of Imperial order and dominance, dated to the present year.
- [Criminal Underworld in Skyrim](https://merethroleplay.com/lore/penitus-skyrim-report/): A report on criminal enterprises, compiled for the Emperor.
